input.criteria:
The classified route and ordered membership are fixed. Analyze only this whole target in full sentence context. Do not repair membership or reclassify. Return Unresolved when a valid analysis is not defensible.
Core Features belong to the dictionary identity, not the current inflection. Occurrence features belong to Surface. Spelling Canonical does not mean Grundform: finite and declined forms may be Canonical. Canonical Form is the exact dictionary headword, not necessarily a copied Surface. Copy an available headword only when the exact candidate already is that headword; otherwise request text.
Standard orthography includes licensed variants and ordinary sentence-initial capitalization. Typo means a real spelling/casing error. Never modernize licensed variants in normalized members. Keep source members positionally aligned; no added or deleted member. Surface spelling is Variant only for a licensed spelling/abbreviation of the same Lemma, never simply an inflection or typo repair. Historical status concerns archaic grammatical use, not merely old spelling or surrounding context.
Citation has null inflection only for a dictionary/citation use or genuinely unmarked invariant use under the route's policy. Contextual finite verbs and ordinary infinitives have marked bags. Structural null is not uncertainty.
For VERB, hasSepPrefix is only a separable lexical prefix, hasGovPrep only a lexically selected preposition (never an adjunct or a detached prefix), lexicallyReflexive only a required reflexive; verbType Mod is a lexical modal identity. Select string values only from code-supplied candidates. AUX identity is a complete reviewed Lemma; compound membership does not require a singleton identity.
For noun suspension, completion is allowed only for one selected trailing-hyphen member in binary und/oder coordination with a full right compound sharing the literal suffix; retain Full coverage. Ordinary uninflected noun forms and dictionary citations remain distinct.
Partial coverage is allowed only for Idiom, DiscourseFormula, Proverb and Aphorism when fixed lexical material is genuinely unrealized and the full identity remains recoverable. Discontinuous or multi-member targets are not Partial merely due to excluded contextual material.Always uninflected. Keep whole multi-member identities such as um zu, ohne zu, statt zu and so … dass. Core conjType Comp describes actual comparative subordination when supported. Preserve licensed separately written or historical variants as occurrence text; only canonical headword uses the conventional dictionary form.

support.instructions: Can this fixed target support a coherent analysis on its supplied route?

criteria.Supported: Yes, keep route and membership unchanged
criteria.Unresolved: No defensible analysis on the supplied target

spelling.instructions: Is the normalized Surface a canonical spelling of its Lemma or a licensed variant? Inflection alone never means Variant.

historicalStatus.instructions: Is the grammatical use of this target archaic?

criteria.Current: Current use, including licensed old spelling
criteria.Archaic: The grammatical use itself is archaic

lemma.coreFeatures.conjType.instructions: What is lemma.coreFeatures.conjType for this exact supplied whole target? Use the route policy and full sentence. Null/Unmarked is a linguistic value, not uncertainty. Answer a speculative branch only if applicable; code will discard other branches.

criteria.Unmarked: Unmarked/inapplicable under the feature's domain policy
criteria.Unresolved: Applicable but no defensible value can be chosen

criteria.Typo: Actual local spelling or casing error

normalization_0.instructions: How should member 0 be positionally normalized? Preserve contextual morphology, licensed variants and source order.

criteria.Keep: Copy the attested member exactly, preserving licensed variants and required capitals
criteria.LowerInitial: Only its first letter has ordinary sentence-initial capitalization; lowercase that first letter
criteria.UpperInitial: Uppercase the initial letter to repair casing or restore required noun/name capitalization
criteria.Generate: Required spelling correction or constrained suspended-noun completion needs new text

canonical.instructions: Is the exact dictionary Canonical Form already one of these copied source candidates? Inflection or Canonical spelling does not establish this. Select only exact available text; otherwise Generate.

criteria.Generate: Required headword is not available as exact text
